html:
Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang is home to a rich flora and fauna, including many rare animals such as wild cats, silver-cheeked ferrets, or the endemic primate population of Indochina – the red-shanked douc langur…

To reach Son Tra Peninsula, visitors should follow the coastline, and freely admire the winding coastline and many famous landmarks. Not only that, when coming here, visitors can also see the nearly 70-meter-high statue of Bodhisattva Guanyin, located in the Linh Ung Pagoda.

Da Nang has 3 Linh Ung pagodas with the same name in one city, and Linh Ung Son Tra Pagoda is one of the spiritual destinations not to be missed when traveling to Da Nang.

Besides the sacred pagoda, Son Tra Peninsula also has many famous landmarks such as: Ban Co Peak, the thousand-year-old banyan tree… the most beautiful is watching the sunrise from the top of Son Tra.

In addition, when coming to Son Tra Peninsula, visitors can also enjoy diving to see corals, with amazing coral reefs, or experience fishing on the weekend, which is an indispensable thing when traveling to Son Tra.

In addition, when coming to Son Tra, visitors can also experience a luxurious resort with a sea view, in addition, visitors can also visit beautiful beaches in Son Tra such as: Tien Sa Beach, Da Den Beach, Rang Beach, But Beach, Xep Beach, Da Beach, Nam Beach, Bac Beach, Con Beach, Trem Beach…

Where to visit when traveling to Son Tra Peninsula?

To help you have a complete tour of Son Tra Peninsula, let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the beautiful attractions in Son Tra Peninsula before having the opportunity to set foot on this beautiful peninsula.

Da Nang Green Lake

A virtual living spot that many tourists come to, visit and take pictures by the clear blue lake reflecting like a mirror, the climate here is relatively cool and fresh. If you love admiring the natural scenery, Green Lake is the destination for you.

Mui Sung

A beautiful check-in spot in Son Tra, a rocky cape jutting out, below is a clear blue stream, if you go on a summer tour to Da Nang, visitors should visit Mui Sung to soak in the cool water, or sit on the jutting rock to take beautiful pictures.

Bai Chay Son Tra

If you are a check-in lover, don’t miss Bai Chay Son Tra, surrounded by reed fields, high rocky mountains, ideal for tourists to take pictures.

Observatory

From the Observatory, you can admire the poetic scenery, especially on clear blue days or in autumn with white reeds covering the horizon, a romantic scene suitable for those who like to check in.

Bai Da Den

Above are the rocks, below is the clear blue water, the waves splashing white foam, you can walk and admire the scenery of the island.

Radar Son Tra

The Radar Station is located at an altitude of more than 621m above sea level, from above you can fully admire the beauty of the city, with clouds floating on the top creating a beautiful natural scene, likened to a fairyland.

Suoi Om

The stream has clear water all year round, with diverse flora, a peaceful space, if you go in a large group, you can experience camping right next to the stream to feel the beauty of nature.

Ban Co Peak

One of the destinations not to be missed when traveling to Son Tra, from above visitors can admire the beautiful scenery of Son Tra.

Tien Sa Lighthouse

If you are a person who loves to admire the scenery and conquer heights, Tien Sa Lighthouse is the destination for you, from here you can admire the scenery of the sea and islands with the boats rushing out to sea, and capture beautiful pictures for yourself.

So to experience those interesting things, come with Vietlook Travel to Da Nang tour today to experience the most interesting things that Son Tra – Da Nang brings to visitors.
